question: The average male literacy rate in India as per the 2011 census was ______.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**82.14%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• It was delayed to 2022 and then further delayed to 2023 due to the COVID-19 pandemic in India. 
 
• Following the postponement of deadline of freezing administrative boundaries to 30 June 2023, and owing to the general elections in 2024, **the census can now only take place in late 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the 2011 census, the literacy rate in India has been reported as 74.04% with a 14% increase from that in 2001.
 
• whereas the hike is maximum for rural women at 26% in the last decade.
 
• The female literacy levels according to the Literacy Rate 2011 census is 65.46% whereas the male literacy rate is over 80%.
 
• The** literacy** rate in the country is 74.04 per cent, 82.14 for males and 65.46 for females.
 
• The highest literacy rate according to the** ****2011 census is Kerala (93.9%) and Mizoram (91.6%).**

• About Registrar General and** Census** Commissioner of India

 
 
• Established in 1961 by the Government of India
 
• Works under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• Objective - To arrange, conduct, and analyze the results of the demographic surveys of India.
 
• Present Chairman - Vivek Joshi ( 1989 batch IAS officer)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first census(1872) in India took place during the reign of **'Lord Mayo'**.

 
 
• The regular** census** in India began in 1881 during the tenure of Lord Rippon.
 
• The Census Commissioner of the 2011 Census was **C. Chandramouli.**
 
• **Lakshadweep is India's smallest** union territory in terms of population.
 
• According to the 2011 census, India's population is **1210 million.**
